lines.text: Lo nuestro duró lo que duran dos [peces] de hielo
lines.english: What we had lasted as long as two fish of ice (ice cubes)
lines.note: peces de hielo: Sabina's famous metaphor for ice cubes melting in whiskey ('on the rocks').

lines.text: En un güisqui on the rocks
lines.english: In a whiskey on the rocks

lines.text: En vez de respirar [humo] de tabaco de liar
lines.english: Instead of breathing rolling tobacco smoke
lines.note: tabaco de liar: Rolling tobacco, widely used in bohemian urban Spain.

lines.text: O llamarme al trabajo y pedirme que no fuera tarde
lines.english: Or calling me at work and asking me not to be late

lines.text: Se puso el [abrigo] de plumas
lines.english: She put on her down coat

lines.text: Y dijo: Te dejo con tu [libertad]
lines.english: And said: I leave you with your freedom

lines.text: Y no le di [importancia], me dije: Otra más que se va
lines.english: And I didn't think much of it; I told myself: Another one leaving
lines.note: dar importancia: Idiom meaning 'to attach importance to' or 'to care about'.

lines.text: Pero pronto me di cuenta de que esta vez iba en serio
lines.english: But soon I realized that this time it was serious

lines.text: Dijo hola y [adiós], y el portazo sonó
lines.english: She said hello and goodbye, and the door slam sounded

lines.text: Como un signo de [interrogación]
lines.english: Like a question mark

lines.text: Sospecho que así se vengaba a través del [olvido]
lines.english: I suspect that's how she got revenge through oblivion

lines.text: Cupido de mí
lines.english: Cupid on me

lines.text: Tardé en [aprender] a olvidarla
lines.english: I took a long time to learn to forget her
lines.note: tardar en + infinitive: Construction expressing the time spent to accomplish an action.

lines.text: Diecinueve [días] y quinientas noches
lines.english: Nineteen days and five hundred nights

lines.text: Dijo hola y adiós, y el [portazo] sonó
lines.english: She said hello and goodbye, and the slam of the door sounded
lines.note: portazo: Augmentative suffix '-azo' indicating a hard blow or slam with a door ('puerta').

lines.text: Como un signo de interrogación
lines.english: Like a question mark

lines.text: La gente me señala, me apunta con el [dedo]
lines.english: People point at me, they point at me with their finger

lines.text: Susurra a mis espaldas y a mí me importa un [bledo]
lines.english: They whisper behind my back and I don't give a damn
lines.note: importar un bledo: Idiom meaning 'not to care at all' or 'to not give a damn'.

lines.text: Qué más me da si soy [distinta] a ellos
lines.english: What do I care if I am different from them

lines.text: No pienso cambiar, no pienso corregirme
lines.english: I don't intend to change, I don't intend to reform myself

lines.text: Si yo no tengo la [culpa] de que no entiendan
lines.english: If it isn't my fault that they don't understand

lines.text: Que no me gustan sus [leyes] ni sus costumbres
lines.english: That I don't like their laws or their customs

lines.text: No pienso callar, no pienso [rendirme]
lines.english: I don't plan to be quiet, I don't plan to surrender

lines.text: Jamás cambiaré, jamás me vencerán
lines.english: I will never change, they will never defeat me

lines.text: ¿A quién le [importa] lo que yo haga?
lines.english: Who cares what I do?
lines.note: importar: Impersonal verb followed by subjunctive clause ('lo que yo haga').

lines.text: ¿A quién le importa lo que yo [diga]?
lines.english: Who cares what I say?
lines.note: diga: Present subjunctive of 'decir'.

lines.text: Yo soy así, y así [seguiré]
lines.english: I am like this, and like this I will continue

lines.text: Nunca cambiaré
lines.english: I will never change

lines.text: ¿A quién le importa lo que yo [haga]?
lines.english: Who cares what I do?

lines.text: ¿A quién le importa lo que yo diga?
lines.english: Who cares what I say?

lines.text: Yo soy así, y así seguiré, nunca [cambiaré]
lines.english: I am like this, and like this I will continue, I will never change

lines.text: Mi destino es el que yo elijo para mí
lines.english: My destiny is the one I choose for myself

lines.text: Bonito, todo me [parece] bonito
lines.english: Beautiful, everything seems beautiful to me
lines.note: parecer: In Spanish, 'parecer' operates like 'gustar' (me parece = 'it seems to me').

lines.text: Bonita mañana
lines.english: Beautiful morning

lines.text: Bonito [lugar]
lines.english: Beautiful place

lines.text: Bonita la cama
lines.english: Beautiful the bed

lines.text: Qué bien se [ve] el mar
lines.english: How good the sea looks

lines.text: Bonito es el día
lines.english: Beautiful is the day

lines.text: Y [acaba] de empezar
lines.english: And it has just begun
lines.note: acabar de + infinitive: Expresses having just done something ('acaba de empezar' = has just begun).

lines.text: Bonita la vida, respira, respira, respira
lines.english: Beautiful life, breathe, breathe, breathe

lines.text: El teléfono suena, mi [pana] se queja
lines.english: The phone rings, my pal complains
lines.note: pana: Colloquial Spanish for 'buddy' or 'pal'.

lines.text: La cosa va mal, la vida le [pesa]
lines.english: Things are going badly, life weighs on him

lines.text: Que vivir así ya no le [interesa]
lines.english: That living like this no longer interests him

lines.text: Que seguir así no [vale] la pena
lines.english: That carrying on like this is not worth the trouble
lines.note: valer la pena: Idiomatic expression meaning 'to be worth it'.

lines.text: Se perdió el amor, se [acabó] la fiesta
lines.english: Love was lost, the party is over

lines.text: Ya no anda el motor que empuja la [tierra]
lines.english: The engine that pushes the earth no longer runs

lines.text: La vida es un chiste con triste [final]
lines.english: Life is a joke with a sad ending

lines.text: El futuro no existe pero yo le digo: Bonito
lines.english: The future does not exist, but I tell him: Beautiful

lines.text: Tonto el que no [entienda]
lines.english: Foolish is the one who doesn't understand
lines.note: subjunctive: 'El que no entienda' uses the subjunctive because the antecedent is generalized/unidentified.

lines.text: Cuenta una leyenda
lines.english: A legend tells

lines.text: Que una hembra [gitana]
lines.english: That a Romani woman

lines.text: Conjuró a la luna hasta el [amanecer]
lines.english: Conjured the moon until daybreak

lines.text: Llorando pedía al llegar el [día]
lines.english: Weeping she asked, upon the arrival of day

lines.text: Desposar un [calé]
lines.english: To marry a Romani man
lines.note: calé: Caló word widely used in Spain to refer to Spanish Romani people.

lines.text: Tendrás a tu hombre, piel [morena]
lines.english: You will have your man, dark skin

lines.text: Desde el cielo habló la luna llena
lines.english: From the sky the full moon spoke

lines.text: Pero a cambio [quiero] el hijo primero
lines.english: But in return I want the first child

lines.text: Que le [engendres] a él
lines.english: That you bear to him
lines.note: engendrar: Subjunctive in relative clause dependent on an unfulfilled requirement.

lines.text: Que quien su hijo [inmola] para no estar sola
lines.english: For whoever sacrifices her child so as not to be alone

lines.text: Poco le iba a querer
lines.english: Would love him very little

lines.text: Luna, quieres ser [madre]
lines.english: Moon, you want to be a mother

lines.text: Y no encuentras [amor] que te haga mujer
lines.english: And you find no love to make you a woman

lines.text: Dime, luna de [plata]
lines.english: Tell me, silver moon

lines.text: ¿Qué pretendes hacer con un niño de nieve?
lines.english: What do you intend to do with a child of snow?

lines.text: Era una tarde tonta y [caliente]
lines.english: It was a silly and hot afternoon

lines.text: De esas que te quema el [sol] la frente
lines.english: One of those where the sun burns your forehead

lines.text: Era el [verano] del noventa y siete
lines.english: It was the summer of ninety-seven

lines.text: Y yo me moría por verte
lines.english: And I was dying to see you

lines.text: Mi Seat Panda se [salía]
lines.english: My Seat Panda was doing great (colloquial)
lines.note: salirse: Colloquial Spanish idiom meaning 'to be awesome / to excel'.

lines.text: Tú me mirabas, yo me [perdía]
lines.english: You were looking at me, I was getting lost

lines.text: Y por la [raja] de tu falda
lines.english: And because of the slit of your skirt
lines.note: raja: Slit, tear or split in a garment.

lines.text: Yo tuve un piñazo con un Seat Panda
lines.english: I had a crash with a Seat Panda
lines.note: piñazo: Spanish slang for a car crash or heavy bump ('darse un piñazo').

lines.text: Por la raja de tu [falda]
lines.english: Because of the slit of your skirt

lines.text: Yo tuve un [piñazo] con un Seat Panda
lines.english: I had a smash-up with a Seat Panda

lines.text: Tú me mirabas, yo no [frenaba]
lines.english: You looked at me, I wasn't braking

lines.text: El parachoques se me saltaba
lines.english: My bumper was flying off

lines.text: Y en la [curva] de la carretera
lines.english: And on the curve of the highway

lines.text: Nos dimos la vuelta a la [carrera]
lines.english: We turned around on the fly / in a rush

lines.text: Y el del [seguro] que no se lo creía
lines.english: And the insurance agent couldn't believe it

lines.text: Cuando el parte de accidente le leía
lines.english: When I read him the accident report

lines.text: Ese cristalito [roto]
lines.english: That little broken piece of glass
lines.note: diminutive: '-ito' adds intimacy and poetic texture ('cristalito').

lines.text: Yo sentí cómo [crujía]
lines.english: I heard/felt how it crunched

lines.text: Antes de caer al [suelo]
lines.english: Before falling to the ground

lines.text: Ya sabía que se rompía
lines.english: I already knew it was going to break

lines.text: Está en la mente [mía]
lines.english: It's in my mind

lines.text: Que no entra en [razón]
lines.english: Which refuses to listen to reason
lines.note: entrar en razón: Idiom meaning 'to listen to reason' or 'to come to one's senses'.

lines.text: Y por la noche en la [esquina]
lines.english: And at night on the corner

lines.text: Sombra de ciprés en la ventana
lines.english: Shadow of a cypress in the window

lines.text: Malamente, tra, [tra]
lines.english: Badly, tra, tra (palmas rhythmic interjection)

lines.text: Mal, muy mal, muy mal, [mira]
lines.english: Bad, very bad, very bad, look

lines.text: Se ha puesto la noche [rara]
lines.english: The night has turned strange

lines.text: Han salío la luna y las estrellas
lines.english: The moon and the stars have come out
lines.note: salío: Andalusian / flamenco colloquial elision of the participial '-ado/-ido' ('han salido' -> 'han salío').

lines.text: Me lo dijo esa [gitana]
lines.english: That Romani woman told me so

lines.text: Mejor no salir a [verla]
lines.english: Better not go out to see it

lines.text: Sueño con que voy en una [barca]
lines.english: I dream that I'm riding in a boat

lines.text: Y de pronto se me para en medio el agua
lines.english: And suddenly it stops in the middle of the water

lines.text: ¿Qué horas son, mi [corazón]?
lines.english: What time is it, my sweetheart?
lines.note: ¿qué horas son?: Plural colloquial phrasing common in Spanish songs for 'what time is it?'.

lines.text: Te lo dije bien clarito
lines.english: I told you loud and clear

lines.text: Permanece a la [escucha]
lines.english: Stay tuned / listening

lines.text: Doce de la noche en La Habana, Cuba. Me gustas tú
lines.english: Twelve midnight in Havana, Cuba. I like you

lines.text: Me [gustan] los aviones, me gustas tú
lines.english: I like planes, I like you
lines.note: gustar: Plural subject 'los aviones' requires 'gustan'; 'tú' requires 'gustas'.

lines.text: Me gusta [viajar], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like traveling, I like you

lines.text: Me gusta la [mañana], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like the morning, I like you

lines.text: Me gusta el viento, me gustas tú
lines.english: I like the wind, I like you

lines.text: ¿Qué voy a [hacer]? Je ne sais pas
lines.english: What am I going to do? I don't know
lines.note: French lines: Manu Chao frequently alternates Spanish, French, and English.

lines.text: ¿Qué voy a hacer? Je ne sais plus
lines.english: What am I going to do? I don't know anymore

lines.text: ¿Qué voy a [hacer]? Je suis perdu
lines.english: What am I going to do? I am lost

lines.text: ¿Qué horas son, mi corazón?
lines.english: What time is it, my sweetheart?

lines.text: Me gusta la [moto], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like the motorbike, I like you
lines.note: la moto: Feminine noun abbreviated from 'la motocicleta'.

lines.text: Me gusta [correr], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like running, I like you

lines.text: Me gusta la [lluvia], me gustas tú
lines.english: I like the rain, I like you

lines.text: Me gusta volver, me gustas tú
lines.english: I like returning, I like you

lines.text: Quizá porque mi niñez sigue jugando en tu [playa]
lines.english: Perhaps because my childhood still plays upon your beach
lines.note: seguir + gerund: Expresses continuity of an action ('sigue jugando' = keeps playing).

lines.text: Y escondido tras las [cañas]
lines.english: And hidden behind the reeds

lines.text: Duerme mi primer [amor]
lines.english: Sleeps my first love

lines.text: Llevo tu luz y tu olor por dondequiera que vaya
lines.english: I carry your light and your scent wherever I may go

lines.text: Y amontonado en tu [arena]
lines.english: And heaped upon your sand

lines.text: Guardo dolor y [alegría]
lines.english: I keep sorrow and joy

lines.text: Tú que me viste [nacer]
lines.english: You who saw me be born

lines.text: Y que me verás morir cerca de tus aguas
lines.english: And who will see me die close to your waters

lines.text: A tus atardeceres [rojos]
lines.english: To your red sunsets

lines.text: Se acostumbraron mis [ojos]
lines.english: My eyes grew accustomed

lines.text: Qué le voy a hacer, si yo [nací] en el Mediterráneo
lines.english: What can I do, if I was born in the Mediterranean
lines.note: qué le voy a hacer: Common Spanish idiom expressing resignation ('what can I do about it?').

lines.text: Nací en el Mediterráneo
lines.english: I was born in the Mediterranean

lines.text: De Algeciras a [Estambul]
lines.english: From Algeciras to Istanbul
lines.note: geography: Spans the full west-to-east expanse of the Mediterranean basin.

lines.text: Para que me pintes de [azul]
lines.english: So that you paint me in blue
lines.note: para que + subjunctive: 'Para que me pintes' expresses purpose.

lines.text: Y con el alma en un [vilo]
lines.english: And with my soul on tenterhooks / in suspense
lines.note: en un vilo: Idiomatic expression meaning 'in anxious suspense / on edge'.

lines.text: Te lo digo cantando: Nací en el Mediterráneo
lines.english: I tell it to you singing: I was born in the Mediterranean

lines.text: Sin ti no [soy] nada
lines.english: Without you I am nothing

lines.text: Una gota de [lluvia] mojando mi cara
lines.english: A drop of rain wetting my face

lines.text: Mi mundo es [pequeño]
lines.english: My world is small

lines.text: Y mi corazón pedacitos de hielo
lines.english: And my heart little pieces of ice

lines.text: Solía pensar que el amor no es [real]
lines.english: I used to think that love is not real
lines.note: soler + infinitive: Expresses habitual action in the past ('solía pensar' = I used to think).

lines.text: Una [ilusión] que siempre se acaba
lines.english: An illusion that always ends

lines.text: Y ahora sin ti no soy [nada]
lines.english: And now without you I am nothing

lines.text: Sin ti niña mala, sin ti niña triste
lines.english: Without you a bad girl, without you a sad girl

lines.text: Que abraza su [almohada]
lines.english: Who hugs her pillow

lines.text: Tirada en la [cama]
lines.english: Lying sprawled on the bed

lines.text: Mirando la tele y no viendo [nada]
lines.english: Watching the TV and seeing nothing

lines.text: Amar por amar y romper a llorar
lines.english: To love for the sake of loving and to burst into tears
lines.note: romper a + infinitive: Idiom meaning to suddenly burst into an action ('romper a llorar').

lines.text: Los días que [pasan]
lines.english: The days that pass

lines.text: Las luces del [alba]
lines.english: The lights of the dawn
lines.note: alba: Poetic feminine noun for the first light of dawn.

lines.text: Mi alma, mi [cuerpo], mi voz
lines.english: My soul, my body, my voice

lines.text: No sirven de nada, porque yo sin ti no soy nada
lines.english: Are of no use at all, because without you I am nothing

lines.text: Estoy cansado de salir de [noche]
lines.english: I am tired of going out at night
lines.note: estar cansado de + infinitive: Expresses weariness of doing something.

lines.text: Y ver siempre la misma [gente]
lines.english: And always seeing the same people

lines.text: Estoy [flipando] de que la gente
lines.english: I am freaked out / amazed that people
lines.note: flipar: Very popular Spanish slang meaning to freak out, be blown away, or hallucinate.

lines.text: Se invente, cuente y luego reinvente
lines.english: Make things up, tell them, and then reinvent them

lines.text: Apoltronado en el [sofá] de mi casa
lines.english: Lounging comfortably in the sofa of my house

lines.text: Viendo cómo pasa el [tiempo]
lines.english: Watching how time goes by

lines.text: Alucinando de que me miren de arriba a [abajo]
lines.english: Tripping out that they look at me from head to toe
lines.note: de arriba a abajo: Idiom meaning 'from top to bottom / from head to toe'.

lines.text: Como a un delincuente
lines.english: Like a criminal

lines.text: Yo quiero entrar en tu [garito] con zapatillas
lines.english: I want to get into your club with sneakers
lines.note: garito: Spanish urban slang for a nightclub, pub or dive bar.

lines.text: Que no me miren mal al [pasar]
lines.english: Without people giving me dirty looks as I pass by

lines.text: Estoy cansado de siempre lo [mismo]
lines.english: I am tired of always the same thing

lines.text: La misma historia, quiero cambiar
lines.english: The same old story, I want to change

lines.text: Me da pena tanta [tontería]
lines.english: All this nonsense makes me sad

lines.text: Quiero un poquito de [normalidad]
lines.english: I want a little bit of normality

lines.text: Yo quiero entrar en tu garito con [zapatillas]
lines.english: I want to get into your club wearing sneakers
lines.note: zapatillas: In Spain, 'zapatillas' specifically denotes casual sneakers / trainers.

lines.text: Que no me miren mal al pasar
lines.english: Without people giving me dirty looks as I pass by
